+import pytest
+
+from cachelib import Cache
+
+
+class FakeClock:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.now = 0.0
+
+    def __call__(self):
+        return self.now
+
+
+def test_default_ttl_expires_entry():
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    c = Cache(ttl=10, clock=clock)
+    c.set("a", 1)
+    clock.now = 9.9
+    assert c.get("a") == 1
+    clock.now = 10
+    assert c.get("a", "gone") == "gone"
+    assert "a" not in c
+    assert len(c) == 0
+    assert c.delete("a") is False
+
+
+def test_per_entry_ttl_overrides_default():
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    c = Cache(ttl=100, clock=clock)
+    c.set("short", 1, ttl=5)
+    c.set("long", 2)
+    clock.now = 5
+    assert "short" not in c
+    assert "long" in c
+
+
+def test_no_ttl_never_expires():
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    c = Cache(clock=clock)
+    c.set("a", 1)
+    clock.now = 1e9
+    assert c.get("a") == 1
+
+
+def test_reset_refreshes_lifetime():
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    c = Cache(ttl=10, clock=clock)
+    c.set("a", 1)
+    clock.now = 8
+    c.set("a", 2)
+    clock.now = 15
+    assert c.get("a") == 2
+
+
+def test_expired_entries_evicted_before_lru():
+    clock = FakeClock()
+    c = Cache(max_size=2, clock=clock)
+    c.set("old", 1, ttl=1)
+    c.set("keep", 2)
+    clock.now = 1
+    c.set("new", 3)
+    assert "keep" in c and "new" in c
+    assert len(c) == 2
+
+
+def test_bad_ttl_raises():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        Cache(ttl=0)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        Cache(ttl=-1)
+    c = Cache()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        c.set("a", 1, ttl=0)

+import pytest
+
+from semverlite.range import intersects, max_satisfying, min_satisfying, satisfies
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("version, rng, expected", [
+    ("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">1.2.3-alpha.3", True),
+    ("3.4.5-alpha.9", ">1.2.3-alpha.3", False),
+    ("2.0.0-rc.1", "<2.0.0", False),
+    ("1.0.0-beta", "*", False),
+    ("1.5.0-alpha", "1.2.3-alpha.1 || ^1.0.0", False),
+    ("2.0.0", ">1", True),
+    ("1.2.0", ">=1.2", True),
+    ("1.1.9", ">=1.2", False),
+    ("1.2.0", "<1.2", False),
+    ("1.2.9", "1.2.x", True),
+    ("1.3.0", "1.2.*", False),
+    ("1.2.0", "1.2 - 2.3", True),
+    ("2.4.0", "1.2 - 2.3", False),
+    ("2.9.9", "1 - 2", True),
+    ("1.3.0", "~1.2.3", False),
+    ("0.2.9", "~0.2.3", True),
+    ("2.0.0", "^1.2.3", False),
+    ("0.3.0", "^0.2.3", False),
+    ("0.0.4", "^0.0.3", False),
+    ("1.0.0", "^0.x", False),
+    ("0.1.0", "^0.0", False),
+    ("1.2.9", "~1.2.3-beta.2", True),
+    ("1.0.0-rc.10", ">1.0.0-rc.2", True),
+    ("1.0.0", "", True),
+])
+def test_satisfies(version, rng, expected):
+    assert satisfies(version, rng) is expected
+
+
+def test_max_and_min_satisfying_keep_strings():
+    vs = ["1.0.0-rc.10", "1.0.0", "0.9.0", "1.0.0-rc.2"]
+    assert max_satisfying(vs, "<2") == "1.0.0"
+    assert min_satisfying(vs, ">=1.0.0-rc.2") == "1.0.0-rc.2"
+    assert max_satisfying(vs, ">2") is None
+    assert min_satisfying([], "*") is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("r1, r2, expected", [
+    (">=1.0.0 <1.0.0", "<=1.0.0", False),
+    ("<=1.0.0", ">=1.0.0", True),
+    (">1.0.0", "<1.0.1", False),
+    (">1.2.3-alpha.3", "<1.2.3-alpha.4", True),
+    (">=1.2.3-alpha.1 <1.2.3", "<1.2.3", False),
+    ("<1.0.0 || >=3.0.0", "3.5.0", True),
+])
+def test_intersects(r1, r2, expected):
+    assert intersects(r1, r2) is expected
+    assert intersects(r2, r1) is expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", ["abc", ">=1.2.a", "1.2.3.4", "=>1.0.0", "1.2.3 -"])
+def test_invalid_range_raises(bad):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        satisfies("1.0.0", bad)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        max_satisfying([], bad)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        min_satisfying([], bad)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        intersects(bad, "*")
+
+
+def test_invalid_version_raises():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        satisfies("1.2", "*")
